details: I join Vrchat for about 10 minutes, then it starts to lag real bad for about 10 seconds every few minutes. I can handle the occasional lag but not every few minutes? Ive stopped playing Vrchat because of this annoying issue. I don't know if this is because im playing on quest. Vrchat sometimes exits the app on its own and says there isnt enough memory when there clearly is, it and other 2 apps are my only games and i have no photos or videos. Ive tried almost everything i can think of to fix this. I deleted photos and videos so now i have none, deleted games i dont use, deleted vrchat game cache, and none of it is working, i still get lag for about 10 seconds where im not able to move my character, head, im not able to look around, everyone freezes and sometimes it gors back to normal and sometimes i have to turn off my headset entirely if i want to go back on it. Ofcourse there will be lag but its so tiring and boring when I get lag every 5 ish minutes. I could be in the middle of a horror game chase and ill die because of that 😂 or i could be in the middle of a conversation and miss what they said. Please fix this issue so i can enjoy vrchat again!!
title: Crash
